fusions.name: Barbed Draw
fusions.desc: A barbed cast on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at the end of its reach, and slows it by 30% for 2 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Landing the Big One
fusions.desc: A heavy hooked blow that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Barbed Welcome
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Caught Fast
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying an affliction, your damage rises by 15%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
